description: Keeps this machine's local database in step with the shared remote database. Only active in hybrid local-first mode; harmless otherwise. Turn off to pause syncing. Applies after a restart.
_note: Wired-in per-process service (app/db/sync SyncEngine, started in main.py before the leader block). main.py ANDs the hybrid-active condition with ability_app_enabled('hybrid_sync'). Descriptor-only by design.
